messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2026-04-13] standup/ember/2026-04-13: Diego has the Ember pager this cycle, taking over from Oskar.
- [2026-04-13] standup/ember/2026-04-13-2: Ember still owns the reporting service, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-01-13] standup/dune/2025-01-13: First on-call rotation for the Dune team goes to Farah.
- [2025-05-13] standup/atlas/2025-05-13: The Atlas team on-call swapped this morning. Priya carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2026-03-02] standup/ember/2026-03-02: Reminder from the Ember team: page Oskar Lind for anything this cycle, not Diego.
- [2026-01-15] standup/ember/2026-01-15: On-call rotation: Diego is primary for Ember starting today; Oskar is off rotation.
- [2026-05-29] standup/ember/2026-05-29: On-call rotation: Oskar is primary for team Ember starting today; Diego is off rotation.
- [2026-03-20] standup/boreal/2026-03-20: Marcus moves from team Boreal to the Atlas team today. On-call for Boreal passes from Marcus to Lena with the move.
- [2026-03-11] standup/cinder/2026-03-11: No deploys to Ledger from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close.
- [2025-03-31] standup/ember/2025-03-31: For anything Ember-related, page Oskar.
- [2026-03-03] standup/cinder/2026-03-03: The auth gateway deploy window (unchanged): on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2026-04-03] standup/cinder/2026-04-03: Cinder runs its planning on Mondays.
- [2026-02-03] standup/atlas/2026-02-03: The Atlas team now does a no-deploy Friday.
- [2025-01-14] standup/ember/2025-01-14: Oskar takes the first the Ember team on-call shift of the year.
- [2026-03-20] standup/atlas/2026-03-20: Priya runs the quarterly capacity review.
- [2026-03-11] standup/dune/2026-03-11: Tomasz has the Dune pager this cycle, taking over from Farah.
- [2025-02-06] standup/ember/2025-02-06: Deploys to the job scheduler happen on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC and at no other time.
- [2025-03-03] handover/2025-03-03-webhooks: From today the pager for webhooks rings the Ember team, not team Boreal. Ownership transferred.
- [2026-05-22] standup/dune/2026-05-22: Tomasz picked up the Dune on-call shift from Farah today.
- [2025-10-13] handover/2025-10-13-ledger: From today the pager for the ledger rings Cinder, not team Atlas. Ownership transferred.
- [2026-02-10] standup/boreal/2026-02-10: Team Boreal on-call swapped this morning. Marcus Oyelaran carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2026-01-16] standup/dune/2026-01-16: On-call rotation: Farah Haddad is primary for team Dune starting today; Tomasz is off rotation.
- [2026-03-09] handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2026-02-11: the flags service went to team Atlas, not Dune. Dune never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2026-03-11] standup/cinder/2026-03-11-2: The Cinder team noticed that billing-api's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.
- [2025-03-07] handover/2025-03-07-billing-api: Billing-api has a new home: the Ember team. Team Atlas kept it until today.
- [2026-05-28] standup/ember/2026-05-28: Ember noticed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.
- [2026-03-17] standup/atlas/2026-03-17: Decided in today's standup: image-resizer will keep original uploads for 90 days only, since storage for originals doubled in six months. For anything Atlas-related, page Priya.
- [2026-03-20] standup/boreal/2026-03-20-2: Observation from the Boreal team: after the retention change, the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent. The Boreal team runs its planning on Thursdays.
- [2025-03-20] handover/2025-03-20-image-resizer: Ownership change: the image resizer now sits with team Ember. Team Dune no longer owns it.
- [2026-06-01] standup/ember/2026-06-01: For newcomers: the deploy window for the reporting service is still on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2026-01-12] handover/2026-01-12-billing-api: Quick one: billing-api belongs to the Ember team starting today. Thanks to the Atlas team for running it until now.
- [2026-02-11] handover/2026-02-11-feature-flags: The Ember team handed the flags service to the Dune team today; Oskar wrote up the handover doc for Farah.
- [2025-03-28] standup/atlas/2025-03-28: Priya still has the Atlas pager.
- [2025-01-09] standup/cinder/2025-01-09: Diego is on call for Cinder to start the year.
- [2025-01-09] standup/atlas/2025-01-09: First on-call rotation for team Atlas goes to Tomasz.
- [2025-03-20] standup/dune/2025-03-20: Reminder: the reports pipeline is owned by Dune.
- [2025-03-17] standup/boreal/2025-03-17: Lena has the Boreal pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus.
